content:
tara: FYI during nebula-v2 quant bring-up we hit a reproducible drop on vertical Korean+Han testset after QAT->int6. Baseline fp16 BLEU=30.8 -> nebula-int6 BLEU=26.3 on the vertical_kr_han_mixed set. Also intermittent mirrored closing-bracket on short RTL spans.

ren: ouch. paste the eval command + raw numbers?

tara: ran on ci-evals: 
```
python tools/eval_translate.py --model=nebula-v2:quant=int6 --testset=data/vertical_kr_han_mixed.jsonl --metrics=bleu,chrf --batch=48
```
metrics: nebula-int6 BLEU=26.3 chrF=42.7 | baseline-fp16 BLEU=30.8 chrF=48.4. eval-bot: stat-diff {"bleu":"-4.5","chrf":"-5.7"} (p<0.01).

hao: can you paste a minimal failing pair (src / ref / nebula-int6) so we can see whether it's tokenization or post-processing?

tara: minimal sample below (kept small):
src: "\uac00\uac01\u3000(\u6ce8)\u300b\u0627\u0628"
ref: "\uac00\uac01\u3000(\u6ce8)\u300d\u53c2\u8003\u0627\u0628"
nebula-int6: "\uac00\uac01\u3000(\u6ce8\u53c2)\u300b\u0627\u0628"
issue: parenthetical content moved before the ref token and the closing bracket rendered as fullwidth close-angle on RTL boundary.

ren: looks like detok merge or bidi reflow ran in the wrong order. Did tokenizer mapping change for this quant build?

tara: token_map stayed the same (token_map_v6.json). During int6 build we enabled a "prefix-coalesce" optimization in runtime that coalesces adjacent detok fragments to save tokens, and we also moved kv-cache trim earlier for performance. Suspect ordering bug: coalesce -> trim -> bidi/detok instead of coalesce -> bidi/detok -> trim.

jeval-bot: quick-smoke subset: nebula-int6-sub BLEU=26.7 -> baseline-sub BLEU=31.0. trend consistent.

hao: i'll run two quick variants on bench-mini: A) int6 with prefix-coalesce disabled; B) int6 with kv-trim deferred until after detok. That should isolate ordering vs coalescing. ETA ~45m.

jo: i've added a tiny human-inspect set (20 samples) to ci/regress/vertical_kr_han_manual.jsonl (PR #4890) focusing on parentheses, ruby, and RTL anchors. Also added a chrF check in the pipeline.

ren: if variant B recovers BLEU, short-term fix is to defer kv-trim for locale/orientation-sensitive flows. longer-term: make coalesce bidi-aware.

tara: action items: hao=run bisect/variants + post hashes, ren=add unit tests for RTL-bracket + ZWJ sequences, jo=maintain harness + human-inspect output. tagging P1 for nebula-v2 onboarding; escalate if full-run stays degraded. :mag:

hao: kicked jobs 3832101140-A and 3832101155-B. will paste sample diffs when done.

(END)
